name: comp-109
title: Toggle Group Buttons
blurb: Three mutually exclusive text-only toggle buttons.
description: A ToggleGroup with type='single' and outline variant showing Left, Center, Right options. Only one can be selected at a time.
use_when: Choosing between three mutually exclusive options with a clean outline style.
avoid_when: When you need icons or more than three options.
a11y: ToggleGroup manages selection state and keyboard navigation automatically.
